en.headline: Man found dead in Shing Mun River near Fo Tan
en.dek: A passer-by spotted a person in the water near Tsui Yung Bridge on Wednesday morning; rescuers recovered a man who was certified dead.
body: A man was found dead in the Shing Mun River in Sha Tin on Wednesday morning after a passer-by reported seeing someone in the water near Tsui Yung Bridge, close to Fo Tan Road.

Police received the report at about 7.50am. Fire services and marine police attended, recovered the man from the river and certified him dead at the scene, according to local news reports citing the authorities.
Police said the man’s identity and the circumstances in which he entered the water were under investigation. No further official details had been released by midday.

zh.headline: 沙田城門河發現男浮屍 身份待查
zh.dek: 星期三早上有途人在沙田翠榕橋附近發現河中有人，救援人員救起一名男子後當場證實死亡。
body: 沙田城門河星期三早上發現一具男屍。途人約7時50分在近火炭路的翠榕橋一帶，看見河中有人載浮載沉，隨即報警。
警方接報後，消防及水警到場將該名男子救起，經檢驗後當場證實死亡。本地傳媒引述當局報道事件。
警方表示，事主身份及墮河原因仍在調查，中午前未有公布更多詳情。
